entries.dialogueText: The door slowly opened and Pabel entered, a fluffy towel in his arms. He hung it on a hook on the wall.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Your Majesty... How much have you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... How much have you been told about your father's death?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Listen, Rom... How much have they..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen, Rom... How much have they told you about your father's death?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was a heart attack. What else w..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a heart attack. What else would I need to know?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I haven't cared enough to go diggi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't cared enough to go digging around."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not a lot. Do you suspect somethin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not a lot. Do you suspect something?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Well, this is what I know...""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, this is what I know..."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Funny you should mention digging.""
entries.dialogueText: "Funny you should mention digging."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""That was the official explanation,..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was the official explanation, yes."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Back when my dad was still alive,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Back when my dad was still alive, he showed me every single plant in the Palas Rezna gardens."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You remember my father, the ground..."
entries.dialogueText: "You remember my father, the groundskeeper. When I was younger, he showed me every single plant in the gardens of Palas Rezna."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""One of them was mandragora. Big gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of them was mandragora. Big green leaves, pretty purple flowers."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""He told me you can make an extract..."
entries.dialogueText: "He told me you can make an extract from its roots. A little bit helps you sleep. More than that causes delirium. And a lot stops your heart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think I see where this is going.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think I see where this is going."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why didn't you ever tell me about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why didn't you ever tell me about this plant?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mandragora? You've been reading to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mandragora? You've been reading too many fantasy novels."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You were the royal heir. Why would..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were the royal heir. Why would you need to know about gardening?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""The name sounds silly, I know. Tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "The name sounds silly, I know. That's why it stuck in my head all these years."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""After he died, I went out to the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "After he died, I went out to the part of the garden where my father had planted the mandragora. Nothing but a smooth patch of dirt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When was the last time you saw the..."
entries.dialogueText: "When was the last time you saw the plants?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who was around the palace that nig..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who was around the palace that night?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""There were only a few people King..."
entries.dialogueText: "There were only a few people King Valero trusted by the end. If my suspicions are correct, it means one of them took advantage of that trust."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You may be right.""
entries.dialogueText: "You may be right."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""And all of those people are still..."
entries.dialogueText: "And all of those people are still in your inner circle today."

entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I only spoke to you when I was spo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only spoke to you when I was spoken to, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you. You're dismissed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. You're dismissed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is there another reason you wanted..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is there another reason you wanted to come in?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I noticed an identical towel on the..."
entries.dialogueText: I noticed an identical towel on the hook next to it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Two towels? Are you crazy, Pabel?""
entries.dialogueText: "Two towels? Are you crazy, Pabel?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a step closer to the tub, c..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a step closer to the tub, conscientiously keeping his eyes on the wall.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Actually, there was something I wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, there was something I wanted to bring up. Without any guards around."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why? Don't you trust the Golden Gu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why? Don't you trust the Golden Guard?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds serious.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds serious."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd really rather not have company..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd really rather not have company in here, Pabel. Save the talk for another day."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""If... if you insist.""
entries.dialogueText: "If... if you insist."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He backed out the door, bowing slig..."
entries.dialogueText: He backed out the door, bowing slightly as he did so.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I don't know whom I can trust, to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know whom I can trust, to be honest."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It might be. Or it might not be. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "It might be. Or it might not be. I'm not sure."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a small stool next to the..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a small stool next to the tub. He moved over to it and sat with his back to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well? What did you want to tell me?""
entries.dialogueText: "Well? What did you want to tell me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need for modesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "No need for modesty."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Oh. Pardon me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. Pardon me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel turned around, still taking c..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel turned around, still taking care to look only at my face. He spoke the next words slowly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel spoke the next words slowly."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel spoke the next words slowly.

entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I know it seems preposterous, but...."
entries.dialogueText: "I know it seems preposterous, but...."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""When I attended to your father on..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I attended to your father on his sickbed, he didn't seem like a man suffering from heart failure. He was in a complete daze, as if he didn't even recognize me."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""A few months before that, maybe. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "A few months before that, maybe. I remembered the flowers blooming."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Could someone have slipped it in h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Could someone have slipped it in his supper?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard enough. It sounds like..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard enough. It sounds like his paranoia was rubbing off on you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. Let's say Father was in..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. Let's say Father was indeed poisoned. What would be the motivation?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""The Queen Mother, obviously. Grand..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Queen Mother, obviously. Grand Wiseman Ignacius. Titus and his men..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel grimaced."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel grimaced.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""So quite the list. Not including m..."
entries.dialogueText: "So quite the list. Not including me, of course.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I was tasting all of His Majesty's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was tasting all of His Majesty's food at that time. So whoever it was would have had to be very creative."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""So yes, it's possible their disapp..."
entries.dialogueText: "So yes, it's possible their disappearance had nothing to do with the King's death."
